en: Black‑and‑white view of a planned residential square with a landscaped central garden, low hedges, a sand or gravel area, and a raised rectangular feature in the middle. Surrounding the square are uniform two‑storey houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows, typical of early 20th‑century German housing estates. A central street leads through an archway in the background building. A tall lamppost stands in the foreground. In the lower left corner the caption reads "Naumburg a. d. Saale".
